lines.text: | Eph 2:12–18 | far off = "having no hope and without God"; "brought near"; hostility killed; peace to far and near | Ch 14, new *Brought near* | the nearness is made, not reached. **I read** two distances closed together |
| Act 17:27–28 | "feel their way toward him … not far from each one of us" | 10.9 | groping toward one who is close |
| Joh 21:7–8 | one sees and says it, Peter leaps, the others come "not far from the land" | 10.9 | **I read** one recognition met three ways, none rebuked |
| Luk 15:19–22 | "still a long way off", the father saw, felt compassion, ran; the rehearsed "hired servants" is never said | 10.10 | **I read** the son's self-rating set aside, not argued with |
| Mar 12:34 | "You are not far from the kingdom of God" | Ch 3 (in place) | the verse was cited without these words |
| Luk 7:4–9 | 10.4 *It reckons* | the elders: "He is worthy"; he: "I am not worthy … I did not presume to come"; Jesus marvelled |
| Act 26:28–29 | 10.6 *A person* | "whether short or long", a wish that all who hear might be as he is, "except for these chains" |
| Act 22:18–22 | 10.2 | Paul expected his past to make them listen; "Up to this word they listened" — hearing ended at "Gentiles" |
| Ecc 12:10–12 | 10.2 | words of delight sought; words of the wise as goads and fixed nails, from one Shepherd. **I read** the figure as two works on the hearer: they move and they fix |
| Mar 12:38–44 (Luk 20:47 carried) | 10.5 *When mouth and heart part* | long prayers for a pretense over the taking of widows' houses; then a widow who says nothing and gives everything |
| Mat 28:11–15 | 10.11 *Hiding another* | the guards told all; money and a story covered it, with safety promised to the carriers of the lie |

- **Route C (7):** Luk 19:12 (a far country; the citizens' "We do not want" in 19:14 is a G2309 verse and is read with group C); Exo 7:19, Gen 1:10, Lev 11:36 (gathered waters; God's "good" in Gen 1 is already in 10.6 and 13.4); 1Co 16:1–2 (the collection, arranged; no inner act stated); 2Sa 22:12 (thick clouds).
